title: Fine-Grained Detoxification via Instance-Level Prefixes for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model-generated texts using Perspective API and Llama-Guard to measure Expected Maximum Toxicity (Exp. Max. Tox.) and Toxicity Probability (Tox. Prob.) across various prompts.
Measuring the generation of negative or hateful language targeting specific identities by utilizing the Perspective API's subtoxicity scoring and self-diagnosis instruction templates.
